This is the course website for BIOL 220 at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.

Use the sidebar to navigate modules. Each module contains three components, each with its own icon in the sidebar:

- <i class="bi bi-easel"></i> **Lecture** -- lecture slides
- <i class="bi bi-terminal"></i> **Lab** -- hands-on practice with R
- <i class="bi bi-pencil-square"></i> **Problem Set** -- graded practice problems
